title: Add Project-Of LUH and UdK Footer Credit to Mit Bestand Aggregator
description: Add a left-side footer credit "Ein Projekt von <LUH-Logo> und <UdK-Logo>" to the Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator, mirroring the existing right-side "Gefördert durch <Zukunft Bau>" funding credit. Reuse the zwischenbericht partner logos (light/dark), place them in ui/asset for chrome serving, and wire the footer item into the OS shell footer layout.
summary:
Added left-side Aggregator footer credit "Ein Projekt von <LUH> und <UdK>" mirroring the right-side "Gefördert durch <Zukunft Bau>".

- Copied light/dark LUH and UdK logos from the Zwischenbericht into `ui/asset/logo/` (served at `/asset/logo/*`).
- Added `LuhLogo`, `UdkLogo`, and `aProjectOfLuhUdkFooterItem` in `ui/js/react`, and made `fundedByZukunftBauFooterItem` locale-aware (`Gefördert durch` / `Funded by`).
- Wired both partner credits into the OS shell footer only for the `entwerfen-mit-bestand` brand: left gap + project-of, flex fill, funded-by + right gap.
- Extended the existing footer chrome unit test; confirmed runtime on the Aggregator at :6023 (DOM text + logo img counts + screenshots in the ticket folder).
